chapters.title: Plan a worker and skill chains

chapters.goal: Practise familiar actions with timing and precision, first with recovery room, then under stricter stock and rescue conditions.
chapters.title: Make deliberate timed assignments

chapters.goal: Start with a generous rescue allowance and a simple skill family. Add group routing, pace, rescue pressure and restricted stock after separate rehearsals. Reported multi-hatch walls close the chapter.
chapters.title: Coordinate entrances and groups

chapters.goal: Combine worker planning, rescue discipline and limited tools after their separate chapters. Put repeated skill-chain practice before Quicky, then reserve more complex combinations for the chapter end.
chapters.title: Combine strict rescue and tool budgets

chapters.goal: Introduce clocks and fast releases in familiar routes, then combine them with limited stock, full rescue and multiple entrances. Use time to first rescue quota, not replay shutdown time.
chapters.title: Work under clocks and fast releases

chapters.goal: Apply the learned tools to longer, less obvious layouts. Alternate complex challenges with familiar routes that retain recovery room. These placements remain editorial assessments of discovery.
chapters.title: Consolidate advanced route planning

chapters.goal: Reserve special pacing, demanding coordination and the owner-confirmed advanced routes for the end. Time waits for no Lemming and This Corrosion remain the closing pair.
